needsBespoke.why: The kit's mechanics (on-hit passive with target debuff, a two-form W with an armed next-attack and an attack reset, an armed next-attack-or-ability explosion on E scaling off target max HP, and a DoT ultimate) are each expressible with existing primitives. The main modeling risk is not a missing primitive but unresolved specifics (see unsettled) such as whether Crash Down's slide is a second hit on the same stationary target and whether Full Tilt is even castable with no allies present.

unsettled.question: Do Ferromancy: Crash Down and Ferromancy: Mount Up share a single ability cooldown, or does each form have its own independent 10s cooldown that only starts counting while that form is active?
options: Single shared 10s cooldown for the W ability slot regardless of form, so dismount->mount->dismount is gated by one timer
Each form (Crash Down, Mount Up) has its own independent 10s cooldown, so casting one does not consume the other's cooldown and Rell can weave dismount/mount more often

unsettled.question: Against a single stationary dummy, does Crash Down's landing-impact damage and its subsequent forward slide constitute two separate damage instances on the same target, or does the target (already airborne/stunned from the landing hit) only take the initial hit?
options: Two separate damage instances: the landing AoE hit, then a second hit as the slide passes over/through the same target's location
One damage instance only: the target is knocked up/displaced by the landing hit and is not positioned to be hit again by the slide
quotes: Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She will continue {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward another 320 units over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Estimated}}, though not through terrain, affecting further enemies along her path.

unsettled.question: Full Tilt (E) targets an allied champion by default (or the closest ally if self-cast/untargeted). In a damage fight with no allies present, can Rell cast E at all, and if so, what does it target/do?
options: E cannot be cast in a fight with zero allies (no valid target exists), so it is excluded from the rotation entirely
E can be self-cast (targeting Rell herself) when no other champion is in range, still arming the next basic-attack/Shattering-Strike explosion
The simulator should treat E as always castable for the purpose of arming the explosion, ignoring its ally-targeting requirement
quotes: If cast without a valid target, or [[self-targeted|self-cast]], ''Full Tilt'' will automatically target the closest allied champion in range.

unsettled.question: Is Mount Up's empowered basic attack (0.2s cast time, 100 bonus range, 40% bonus AS, dash-to-target) faster or slower overall than Rell's normal auto-attack cadence, i.e., does using it every 10s cooldown gain or cost total auto-attack damage over the 15s window versus just autoattacking normally?
options: The 0.2s fixed cast time plus dash travel time makes the empowered attack slower than continuing normal autoattacks at high attack speed, so it should be minimized/delayed
The 0.2s cast time is fast enough (and it triggers an attack reset) that using it on cooldown is a net DPS gain over skipping it
quotes: empowering her next basic attack within {{fd|3.5}} seconds to have a {{fd|0.2}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}

proposal: Start Mounted (Rell's default state) at the start of the fight.
Cast W (Ferromancy: Crash Down) onto the dummy immediately to dismount, dealing the landing magic damage (and slide damage if it applies to a stationary target), and gain the shield.
Cast Q (Shattering Strike) on the dummy for its magic damage.
If a valid E target exists (see unsettled), cast E (Full Tilt) to arm the next basic attack or Q with the bonus max-health explosion, then land it via the next auto-attack or the next Q cast.
Cast R (Magnet Storm) on the dummy as soon as it is off cooldown (120/100/80s CD, likely only usable once in a 15s window) for its DoT.
Auto-attack the dummy continuously between ability casts so Break the Mold's on-hit bonus damage and stacking shred apply on every hit.
Recast W (Ferromancy: Mount Up) once dismounted and off cooldown to arm the next basic attack with its bonus magic damage and reset the attack timer, then immediately attack the dummy to consume it.
Recast W (Crash Down) again once its cooldown is up to redismount and repeat the landing damage plus another shield/mount-up-attack cycle for the remainder of the 15s.
Recast Q on cooldown throughout for its flat magic damage.
Weave normal auto-attacks in all remaining time to keep Break the Mold's on-hit procs and stacks near their cap.
